Asset type: single icon-only aperture logo exploration for the app kollens.
Input image: edit target, existing gold three-blade aperture logo.

Completely remove ALL of the central K, all letter-like diagonals, stem and monogram geometry. Replace the middle with a clean round optical opening surrounded by three equal broad swept blades at exactly 120 degrees. The aperture blades alone are the whole mark; no outer ring.

Avoid: texture, grain, gradients, emboss, mockups, shadows, coin signs, letters, nodes, background color or any lettering.
